meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin **acne-prone / oily** hai aur budget **₹700 ke andar** hai, to meri **best pick** hogi **2% Salicylic Acid serum**. Salicylic acid active pimples, blackheads aur clogged pores ke liye sabse direct option hota hai, aur under-₹700 options bhi kaafi mil rahe hain.[4][6][7]

**Mere top recommendations:**

- **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — acne-prone, oily, sensitive skin ke liye strong budget option; price around **₹467**.[7]
- **Myupchar 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — acne, pimples aur open pores ke liye listed at **₹539**.[6]
- **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — acne, blackheads aur open pores ke liye, sale price around **₹599.25**.[8]
- **Pilgrim Anti-Acne Face Serum / 10% Niacinamide Serum** — acne marks aur oil control ke liye, around **₹649–₹650**.[5]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — agar active pimples se zyada **acne marks** aur oil control concern hai, to yeh under **₹700** available hai.[1][2]

**Simple choice guide:**
- **Active pimples / blackheads**: **2% Salicylic Acid** serum lo.[4][6][7][8]
- **Acne marks / post-acne pigmentation**: **Niacinamide** ya **Azelaic Acid** serum better rahega.[1][2][5]
- **Sensitive skin**: pehle **low-irritation** option, jaise **Cica + Salicylic Acid** ya **Niacinamide**, consider karo.[7][10]

**Agar ek hi serum choose karna ho:**  
**Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** under ₹500 me sabse balanced budget option lagta hai acne-prone skin ke liye.[7]

Agar chaho, main **oily skin**, **dry acne-prone skin**, ya **sensitive skin** ke hisaab se 3 exact product picks shortlist kar du.
